hydration.name: Drink water
hydration.description: Have a glass of water with each meal.

exercise.name: Move for 20 minutes
exercise.description: A walk, a stretch or a workout. Anything that gets you moving.

sleep.name: Go to bed on time
sleep.description: Head to bed at the same time each night.

reading.name: Read for 15 minutes
reading.description: A few pages of a book before the day ends.

mindfulness.name: Take five quiet minutes
mindfulness.description: Sit, breathe and let your mind settle.

screentime.name: Screens off before bed
screentime.description: Put your phone away 30 minutes before you sleep.

diet.name: Eat some vegetables
diet.description: Add one portion of fruit or vegetables to your day.

other.name: Daily check-in
other.description: Take a moment each day to note how it went.
